fixed_case.scope: complete 3-D small-strain isotropic elasticity with continuous MLS and global unshifted normalized F1 enrichment; operator and manufactured-field diagnostic only

geometry.coordinate_frame: global xyz; centered cylinder and straight z-axis front

sources.support_radius_role: fixed MLS numerical support length h; not a material parameter
sources.front_set_T_F: all 27 sources; this is only a global algebraic bridge because every fixed support contains the straight front

material_and_manufactured_field.model: full 3-D isotropic linear elasticity with UX/UY/UZ; benchmark parameters do not describe ceramic material
material_and_manufactured_field.front_coefficient: A*sqrt(R), units m; same value for each of the 27 FRONT_F1_UNSHIFTED coefficients
material_and_manufactured_field.base_coefficients: all 81 UX/UY/UZ BASE coefficients equal 0 m
material_and_manufactured_field.front_coefficients: all UX and UY FRONT_F1 coefficients equal 0 m; all 27 UZ FRONT_F1 coefficients equal A*sqrt(R) m
material_and_manufactured_field.exact_stress: sigma_xz=sigma_zx=mu*duz/dx; sigma_yz=sigma_zy=mu*duz/dy; all other stress components are zero
material_and_manufactured_field.front_coefficient_by_component: UX=UY=0 m; UZ=A*sqrt(R) m for every source

dofs.field_component: UX, UY, and UZ for each source and each basis family
dofs.MLS_visibility: continuous MLS; no visibility mask or source deletion
dofs.semantic_id_cardinality: 27 source IDs x 3 components x 2 basis kinds = 162 unique DofKey canonical IDs

end_caps.scalar_uz_traction: tz=0 on both caps; tx and ty remain part of the full 3-D traction and full-vector boundary load diagnostic
end_caps.radial_parameterization: r=R*s^2, s in (0,1), using GL4 in s

quadrature.front_and_branch_cut_queries: excluded by positive radial nodes and open-interval Gauss nodes; no epsilon offset

limitations: all-site front enrichment is a global algebraic bridge only, not local enrichment qualification or a convergence study
the full tensor operator uses lambda=E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2nu)) and mu=E/(2*(1+nu)); the engineering-strain order is [exx,eyy,ezz,gammaxy,gammayz,gammaxz]
the exact Mode III strain is singular as r approaches zero; small-strain linear elasticity is a near-tip LEFM limit away from the mathematical front and has no finite-strain/core model
positive radial Gauss nodes avoid evaluating the singular front but do not create a radial hole; one fixed finite quadrature rule is not evidence of convergence
the 1.3e-6 J exact energy and E=1 MPa, nu=0.3, KIII=100 Pa*sqrt(m) are synthetic benchmark values and are not ceramic material calibration
six semantic rigid modes are BASE-only translations/rotations; extra near-zero eigenvalues or significant negative eigenvalues fail the diagnostic without ridge, pseudoinverse, or truncation
no solver, displacement constraints, reactions, SIF extraction, crack propagation, CAD, or material calibration

loading.outer_cylinder: full traction t=sigma*n from the exact Mode III stress; on lateral normal n=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0), only tz may be nonzero
loading.crack_faces: zero traction on both faces of x<0,y=0; this analytic condition is not a sampled branch-face query

boundary_conditions.load_application: assemble/report full-vector boundary load and exact field work only; no solver is invoked

analytic_wrench.interpretation: analytic sigma*n boundary wrench; compare with integrated traction wrench and six BASE-only rigid virtual works f dot r

dimensions.basis_partition_of_unity_mapping: scalar BASE/F1 rows lifted to UX/UY/UZ vector basis then reordered by DofKey canonical IDs

constitutive_and_operator.formula: K = sum_q B.T @ D @ B * dV; all 6 engineering strains and full isotropic lambda/mu coupling

full_vector_boundary_load.traction_source: exact sigma*n on cylinder side and both end caps; zero crack-face traction is analytic and not sampled across the branch cut

integrated_boundary_wrench_and_rigid_vir.cap_radial_parameterization: r=R*s^2, s in (0,1), dA=2*R^2*s^3 ds dtheta; GL4 x GL8

static_solve_replay.array_encoding: JSON nested arrays; row-major in declared dimensions
static_solve_replay.coefficient_order: registry.ordered_keys; canonical IDs and ordered keys align by slot

sources.rigid_mode_rotation_definition: omega cross (source_position - source_centroid), with omega in radians and no division by R
